hero.title: SailCast is ready
hero.body: Safety ratings, sailing windows and the week calendar are on the way. For now, this page shows the spots, boats and sailors SailCast knows about.

start: Add a spot, a boat and a sailor to get started.
manage: Add or edit spots, boats and sailors
manage_admin_only: An administrator can add spots, boats and sailors in Settings.
advisory: SailCast is advisory. Official forecasts and warnings come first, and the skipper decides.
